title: Heart failure: type, acuity and hypertension
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any related hypertension.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for heart failure.

HPI
Pt is a 56-year-old female presenting for routine follow-up of chronic systolic heart failure. Pt reports feeling well today. Denies any shortness of breath, increased swelling in lower extremities, or recent weight gain. She states she is adhering to her current medication regimen and diet. No new symptoms since last visit.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Carvedilol 12.5mg BID
Spironolactone 25mg daily
Furosemide 40mg daily
Metoprolol Succinate 25mg daily

Exam
BP: 118/74, HR: 72, RR: 16, SpO2: 98% on RA. Pt in no acute distress. CTAB. Heart: RRR, no murmurs. Lungs: Clear to auscultation. Extremities: No edema.

Assessment
1. Chronic HFrEF: Stable. Pt currently asymptomatic with no signs of volume overload.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Continue low-sodium diet and fluid restriction.
3. F/u in 3 months for routine check.

Electronically signed
D. Kowalski, MD
05/14/2026
